name: Coatue Management
seen_with: Jeff Bezos (Blue Origin $10B outside funding round, 2026-07-08)
rationale: LEAD investor in Blue Origin's first-ever outside capital raise, committing a dedicated $4B of the $10B round at a $130B valuation -- the anchor check that let Bezos backstop with 'only' $2B personally. A hedge/growth fund crossing into space-launch megadeals at this scale, alongside a watchlist individual, is a new allocator worth tracking in its own right (Coatue also backed SpaceX, Databricks, Instacart per its own coverage).
